content.text: She marks when she is free
Miss Dona, adult family home owner

Shifts and steady jobs.
No agents. No fees.
Lydia has picked up shifts on ShiftKind.
She marks the days and nights she is free each week.
Homes that are short see who is free, and offer her the shift.
Now she wants a steady job.
In the group chats, agents post live-in jobs
and ask for a fee first.
Miss Dona needs a live-in caregiver who will stay.
She posts the job herself: live-in or live-out,
the hours, the pay and the start date.
Lydia sees the real home, the pay and the distance,
and applies with a short note.
Miss Dona sees her verified credentials,
shortlists her, and messages her directly.
Lydia asked a home she worked for to write a recommendation,
and she chose to show it.
The home pays her directly, and nobody takes a cut.
